reply.emotion: craving something sugary, happy and satisfied
notes: Dulce can describe both food with a high sugar content and a gentle, pleasant personality.

senses.definition: Que tiene un sabor parecido al del azúcar o la miel.

examples.text: Esta fruta está muy dulce y madura.
examples.translation: This fruit is very sweet and ripe.
examples.emotion: pleasantly surprised by the rich flavour

senses.definition: Dicho de una persona, que es suave, amable y cariñosa en su trato.

examples.text: Ella tiene una voz muy dulce.
examples.translation: She has a very gentle voice.
examples.emotion: warm and affectionate, speaking of someone dear
